dataset_name: Target for the overnight rate (business daily)
description: Also called the policy interest rate, the average rate that the Bank of Canada wants to see in the market for overnight money market financing. (V39079)

licence.name: Bank of Canada Terms of Use
licence.conditions: Free to use, copy and distribute. Attribute the Bank of Canada as the source and indicate any changes. Bank of Canada exchange rates are for statistical and analytical purposes only, not for executing trades.

access: Public. Free, no account or API key required. The Bank's terms prohibit circumventing its request limits.
retrieval_method: Bank of Canada Valet REST API: observations/{series}/json returns the full history of the requested series together with each series' label, description, unit and frequency. The response is stored unchanged as the raw file.
frequency_basis: declared by Bank of Canada (Business daily)
update_frequency: business daily; changes announced on 8 scheduled dates a year at 09:45 ET, effective the next business day

reproducibility_rating.basis: 2 retrievals produced the same raw data (sha256:cfde423daba4...), on 2026-10-24

quality_notes: 4554 rows in raw file; 4554 rows in processed file (Canada). Missing values: 0 of 4554 observations have no value (0.0%): none. Validation passed.
known_limitations: A change announced at 09:45 ET takes effect the next business day. Unlike the market series, the rate is also published on holidays (it stays constant). Valet history starts 2009-04-21; earlier values are in the Bank's legacy archives

checks.detail: same columns and dimensions as the previous retrieval (version 1)
